hindsight: S&P upgraded United Rentals to BBB- from BB+ (read by Joel 2026-10-09, reported as that day), after a positive outlook around April to July 2026. All after the 10-K filing.
Joel looked up current ratings while writing this expectation.
discussion: Confirmed by Joel 2026-10-09. Match after a method fix. Tranche first FLAGged on the combined severe case (cash-flow DSCR 0.97x) because the $1,459M AR securitization, which renews every 364 days, was counted as principal due. Joel ruled that renewing facilities are refinancing risk, not scheduled debt service. With that rule, severe-case cash-flow DSCR is 2.62x and Tranche PASSes. Not blind on the rating: Joel saw the October 2026 upgrade to BBB- while writing.
